title: Product Manager, Core Experience
description:
In just five years, Stora has become the platform behind more than 30% of UK self storage locations, and we're scaling globally from here. Operators have processed over £150m in automated payments through us, and see an average of 32% business growth after they switch.

We're doing this in a market that's wide open. Europe has over 10,000 self storage sites and is growing fast, yet it sits years behind the US on maturity and is still barely touched by good software. The UK is our stronghold. The rest of Europe is where we're heading next.

Stora is the operating system for modern self storage: online bookings, payments, facility management, reporting, and automation in one platform. We started as operators ourselves, and that's still how we think. If you want to own a product operators depend on every day, in a company genuinely rethinking how it builds, this is it.

Why this role matters

We have a strong product team, great engineers, and a growing product. The bottleneck isn't ideas or execution capacity. It's people who can hold the full picture at once.

What the business needs, what the customer actually experiences, what's technically feasible, what to cut when time is short, and knowing when to slow down. Making good calls across all of it. That's the job.

We've shortened the loop between insight and shipped product by stripping out the layers that slow good judgement down. The quality bar didn't move. This role exists to keep doing that. It carries real ownership from day one, and the scope grows as Stora does.

The surface you'd own

This is the product operators live in every day, and the storefront their own customers book through. You're designing for two users at once: the operator running the business, and the end customer renting the unit. Getting that B2B2C experience right is a genuine craft problem. It's a broad, central surface, and it's heavy on UX.

Concretely, the surface includes:

  • Core workflows: customers, units, tenancies, access

  • Roles, permissions, account structure

  • Operational reporting: occupancy, utilisation, activity

  • The internal data layer: event tracking, core models, metric definitions

  • The growth surface: storefront, checkout, the lead → booking funnel

If an operator uses it daily, or relies on it to understand their business, it sits with this team.

How we actually work

We've changed how product gets built at Stora. This is how we operate now.

Designers work directly in the codebase. Engineers and product people work closely together from the start. We use AI genuinely: to explore, prototype and move faster. The work gets closer to reality, sooner.

If you're at a company that talks about moving faster but runs the same process it did three years ago, this will feel different. We're not done evolving how we work, and this person will have real scope to shape that.

What you'll do

  • Own a problem space end-to-end, from understanding the customer need to something live in the product

  • Work across both sides of the experience: operator back office and end-customer storefront

  • Work directly with engineering leads. Close collaboration, not handoff

  • Make scope calls. Know what to cut, what's fundamental, what can wait

  • Work with or without a designer, depending on the problem. What matters is the outcome

  • Stay close to customers, talk to operators, understand how they run their businesses, bring that into every decision

  • Shape how we work. The process isn't fixed. If something's slowing things down, fix it

What you'll bring

  • Real product experience at a SaaS company. You've owned features or problem spaces end-to-end and shipped things people use. Roughly 2+ years, though we care more about the evidence than the number

  • A builder by instinct. You make things: side projects, tools, a company you tried to start. We'd rather see someone who ships than someone who only plans

  • A design or engineering past works too. You may have come from design, engineering, or somewhere else entirely. Designers and people who've started their own things tend to do well here

  • Great product taste. You can tell the difference between a solution that works and one that just ships

  • You define it yourself. You don't need everything defined to make progress

  • Real design sense. Strong enough to contribute or push back, which matters a lot on a surface this UX-heavy

  • AI-native. You use AI as a natural part of how you think and work. Not waiting to be shown how

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before you can start

  • You've only ever worked inside someone else's process and haven't shipped anything of your own

  • You think good product work stops before it ships

  • You go quiet when a problem is ambiguous instead of pushing into it

Why Stora

  • A category-defining surface to own. Self storage software is wide open, and the core experience is the heart of it. You set the direction here, you don't inherit it.

  • Work that ships, and that you feel. We've stripped out the layers between insight and shipped product. What you build reaches operators in weeks, not quarters.

  • A team that builds differently. Designers in the codebase, AI used for real, process that bends when it should. Small team, outsized impact.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Share options

  • Remote across the UK & Europe, or hybrid from our Belfast office

  • 35 days holiday

  • Private health insurance (for you + family)

  • Company pension plan

  • Apple hardware

  • Learning & development support

Next steps

When you apply, we'll ask for a link to something you've made — a product, a side project, a repo, a tool you built because something annoyed you. It doesn't need to be polished, successful, or related to storage. We just want to see that you build. Please include one.

We're reviewing applications as they come in and will be in touch quickly if it looks like a match.

title: Senior Support Engineer, EU
description:

Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

  • Lead investigations into ambiguous or high-severity issues and liaise during incidents, maintaining clear communication throughout.

  • Produce high-quality minimal reproductions, reusable code snippets, and structured issue reports.

About you:

  • Remote in the UK or Ireland

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in developer support or engineering roles.

  • Strong experience debugging complex JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web applications (e.g., Next.js).

  • Demonstrated success in independently owning complex issues from diagnosis to resolution.

  • Ability to elevate those around you through thoughtful collaboration, clear communication, and informal mentorship.

  • Competitive salary and stock options program

Who we are:

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised an $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

title: Investor Relations Associate v2
description:
We are hiring an Investor Relations Associate to help grow the investor side of Paires, the network of family offices and high-net-worth individuals our founders raise from.

Paires is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

The craft of this seat is allocator trust, and we are hiring people early in that craft who are already showing they have it. You will work alongside our senior investor team on live mandates: qualifying allocators, preparing briefs, running follow-ups, and keeping investor relationships warm between deals. And from day one you will build your own: identifying family offices and HNWIs who back US startups, earning first conversations, and growing a book that is yours.

You do not need a decade of relationships. You need the beginnings of a real network, a method for growing it that you can explain, and the discipline to treat other people's capital and privacy with care. The rest, the mandate craft, the briefing standard, the judgment calls, you learn here, working next to people who do this every day. One thing this seat is not: technical. Our engineers build the platform and the agents. You work inside them, so your hours go to investors instead of admin.

What you will own

  • Your growing book. The allocator relationships you bring and the ones you open here, qualified and kept warm.

  • Mandate support that matters. Investor qualification, briefing notes, and follow-through on live deals, done to the house standard.

  • New doors. A monthly rhythm of first conversations with family offices and HNWIs who are new to Paires.

  • Your development. Every investor call you shadow and every brief you write compounds into the senior version of this seat.

You are a fit if you

  • Have started building an allocator network for real, through a seat in wealth management, private banking, a family office, placement, or your own hustle, and can show relationships you opened yourself.

  • Can explain your method. How you find the right investors, how you earn the first conversation, and how you stay useful to them after it.

  • Know what your investors actually do with their money, and ideally that includes direct allocations into US startups.

  • Listen more than you pitch. Allocators trust you because you never waste their time, and you would rather lose a meeting than force one.

  • Treat discretion as a reflex. Names, allocations, and conversations stay confidential, always.

  • Work like it's 2026. AI tooling runs your pipeline and prep, so your hours go to people.

What we offer

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid. A senior team to learn the craft from, live deal flow from week one, and a seat that grows into managing your own side of the network.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application. Do not include investor names anywhere in it. We evaluate composition, not contacts.

title: Founding Tech Lead (Dual Use Defence & Health-tech) - Tricorder
description:
Build the operating system for healthcare beyond the hospital

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity, a data centre down the corridor and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient ever reaches a ward.

Tricorder is building the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform for clinical teams to capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when networking or the grid can't be relied on.

We are building this from scratch inside Founders Factory's studio, with a dedicated pre-seed investment, hands-on studio support across product, design, talent and growth, and a six-month build programme to get from concept to a fundable, in-market product. This venture has secured a major European industrial partner to provide hardware, sandbox testing, RnD capabilities. The founding CEO is already in place. We are now looking for the technical other half of the founding team.


The role

You will be the founding Tech Lead. This is a builder's role before it becomes a management role. In the early studio days you will be hands-on across hardware and software, making pragmatic architectural calls under real uncertainty, and turning a concept and early customer conversations into a working, demonstrable product.

You'll work hand in hand with the founder & CEO on product direction, pilot deployments, and technical documentation for future funding rounds. You will be responsible for defining the initial technology stack and building the core engineering team.

What you'll own

You will have end-to-end responsibility for:

  • System Integration: Working with integrated sensing, edge computing, and building out data synchronization layers to complete an OS.

  • Architectural Design: Building resilient systems for environments with intermittent connectivity and power constraints.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring alignment with medical device regulations, data protection standards, and quality management frameworks.

  • Product Validation: Delivering functional prototypes for clinical pilots and investor demonstrations.

  • Team Leadership: Recruiting and managing the initial engineering team as the company scales.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a rare combination: someone who can build hardware and regulated software together, and who wants to do it as a founder rather than an employee.

Strong candidates will bring most of the following:

  • A track record of shipping real products, ideally spanning both physical devices and the software that runs on and around them. You’ve taken something from prototype to something people actually use, not just research or internal demos.

  • Depth in one or more of: embedded systems / firmware, sensors and signal acquisition, edge compute, or connected-device architecture.

  • Experience building in a regulated, high-trust domain: health-tech, medical devices, defence, or a comparable safety-critical field, and comfort with the standards and evidence that come with it (e.g. clinical safety, data protection, medical-device / quality management frameworks).

  • Pragmatism and speed at the earliest stage: you make good build-vs-buy calls, ship, and are comfortable with ambiguity and imperfect information.

  • Founder wiring: you want ownership and equity, you can carry the technical story with clinical users and investors, and you can hire and raise the bar without slowing everyone down.

  • A reason to care: something you've seen, built or lived that makes this problem feel important and solvable to you.

Nice to have

  • Advanced knowledge of AI/ML for on-device inference or sensor fusion.

  • Experience as a founding engineer or early employee at a technology startup.

  • Exposure to clinical, pre-hospital, emergency, humanitarian or field-operations environments.

  • Familiarity with the realities of getting hardware manufactured and certified.

  • Pre-existing security clearance with UKSV

Probably not the right fit if

  • Your experience is mostly software-only, or mostly hardware-only, and you're not excited to work across the seam of the two.

  • You've worked mainly inside large organisations with mature processes and large teams, and need that structure to be effective.

  • You want to design the perfect architecture before understanding the users, the constraints and the regulatory path.

  • You're looking for a senior IC or corporate CTO title rather than a genuine co-founder role at pre-seed pace.

Why build with Founders Factory

Founders Factory provides structured support through a dedicated studio team specializing in product, design, and growth. This role offers co-founder equity and a stipend during the six-month build phase, positioning the CTO for a long-term leadership role in the resulting company.

As part of your application, we'd love to know

  1. What have you seen, experienced, or learned that makes you believe this problem is both important and solvable?

  2. What unique advantage, experience, network, or insight do you bring that would give you an edge in building this company?

  3. What are the three most important milestones you would achieve during our six-month studio build programme, and why?

Compensation: Founder-level stipend during the studio build programme + significant founding tech lead equity with standard vesting.

Security clearance: Parts of our work will sit in national-security-adjacent settings. Candidates should be willing and able to undergo UK government security vetting if not already held.

title: Venture Builder | HealthTech (London)
description:
👋 Hey, we're Founders Factory

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Headquartered in London and operating globally, Founders Factory backs visionary founders with capital, dedicated support from a team of expert operators, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry leading corporate partners. Since 2015, FF has backed 450+ portfolio companies helping them to secure over 500 enterprise pilots with blue chip corporate partners such as Aviva, Northwestern Medicine, Johnson & Johnson Innovation, and HSBC.

The Opportunity:

Health systems globally are burdened by capacity constraints, rising chronic disease, aging populations, and escalating operational costs. Care delivery models built around physical hospitals are increasingly unsustainable. Advances in connected devices, remote diagnostics, and AI-enabled monitoring now make it possible to safely move large parts of care beyond hospital walls while improving outcomes and patient experience.

The big promise of technology in this space is to enable continuous, proactive, and lower cost care particularly across long-term condition management or home-based / community care while allowing scarce clinical resources to focus where they matter most.

We are looking for exceptional Venture Builders who are passionate about building the future of healthcare delivery.

 

🔍 Who are we looking for?

As a Venture Builder, you specialise in taking ideas from zero to venture-backable businesses. You work closely with founders to shape strategy, validate problem spaces, build MVPs, and find early product market fit. This is a hands on, high ownership role. title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

  • Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation.

  • Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies.


Benefits

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll own our People operations, systems and data across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle - from onboarding, offboarding and Right to Work through to colleague requests, payroll processes, benefits and compliance. You'll make sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for ways to simplify, automate and improve them.

Data is a big part of this role. We need someone who's genuinely at home in the numbers - happy getting into a complex spreadsheet, reconciling different data sources, spotting inconsistencies and using data to understand what's happening rather than simply reporting what it says.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and automation can remove repetitive work across People Operations. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be curious, willing to experiment and excited about what technology could make better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it. Numbers don't scare you - quite the opposite.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

In practice:

  • You're naturally curious, analytical and highly numerate, with advanced Excel skills and the confidence to work independently with complex data.

  • You love improving how things work and have redesigned and implemented processes, rather than simply inherited and administered them.

More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. 
 
In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. 
 
Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. 
 
Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign.
 
Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others.
 
More in Common has a range of exciting projects in the pipeline, including:

title: Strategic Client Manager
description:

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers, owning the relationship and making sure they get the very best from us.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving.

You’ll have the opportunity to build our corporate client management approach from the ground up: shaping account reviews and performance reporting, bringing together claims, safety, underwriting and finance for our biggest clients, and taking real ownership when something needs to get done. Success is simple: our clients stay with us, get more value from Flock and recommend us to others.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business.

  • Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning.

  • Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every client.

  • Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations.

  • Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts.

  • Support the commercial management of the smaller number of corporate clients that work with Flock directly.

  • Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 

What you’ll need

  • Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

  • Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

  • A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them.

  • The ability to work effectively within a broker-led relationship, knowing when to lead, when to support the broker and when to bring in specialist colleagues.

  • Energy and ownership: comfortable picking up a problem and driving it through to a solution, and confident using AI in your daily work to work faster and deliver a better client experience.

  • Preferable: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to the claims process or to building an account management or client service proposition.

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

title: Ingénieur.e : Évaluation de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles – CDD 12 mois
description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’Ingénieur.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, formation, et innovation ; affecté au Centre Microélectronique de Provence. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et intérêt pour la recherche appliquée.

Le département Systèmes et Architectures Sécurisés (SAS), du Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), étudie la sécurité des composants électroniques et des données qu’ils contiennent (tels que des clefs de cryptographie, des logiciels, des blocs de propriété intellectuelle, des données en mémoires, etc.) vis-à-vis de manipulations frauduleuses couramment appelées “attaques” matérielles. Les enseignants-chercheurs du département SAS contribuent au développement de protections matérielles, logicielles, et cryptographiques contre ces attaques, et plus largement à la proposition de solutions de sécurité pour les objets mobiles.

Le département SAS est associé au CEA Leti dans une équipe commune, l’EC SAS, comprenant actuellement 32 personnes.

 

Le recrutement d’un.e Ingénieur.e de recherche en Sécurité Matérielle s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet SecMemPCM financé par la Région Sud. Votre mission est une mission de recherche sur le sujet de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles.

 ·         Vous assurez un travail de recherche sur la susceptibilité des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles émergentes (eNVM) aux attaques matérielles, et plus particulièrement aux attaques par injection de fautes.

·         Vous menez des essais expérimentaux de caractérisation du comportement de divers types de eNVM face aux attaques par injection de fautes. Vous analysez les résultats afin de comprendre et modéliser les mécanismes associés.

·         Vous rendez compte des activités et des résultats qui relèvent des missions dont vous aurez la charge.

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à conduire un travail de recherche sera essentielle pour réussir.

 


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent, ou d’une thèse.

Vous avez des compétences scientifiques en Microélectronique et/ou en sécurité matérielle.

Et idéalement :

·      Avec une expérience dans le domaine de la sécurité matérielle et des techniques d’injection de fautes.

·      Junior accepté : Oui

·      Une maîtrise de l’anglais (niveau C1).

 

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

•           Vous êtes titulaire d’une thèse en microélectronique et/ou sécurité matérielle.

•           Vous possédez une expérience pratique des techniques d’injection de fautes.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

·           Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

·           Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

·           Une qualité de vie incomparable : 46 /49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

title: Supply Chain Planner (all genders) - PARIS - CDD
description:
About this role

  • Warehouse coordination: You are the main point of contact for day-to-day operations with the EU HUB warehouse, fostering a collaborative and efficient working relationship.
  • Order management: You oversee the preparation of customer orders and track shipments for a diverse client base — including 3PLs, agents, distributors and subsidiaries — and set priorities.
  • Delivery tracking: You coordinate order pickup with carriers (EU/non-EU) and track invoicing.
  • Customer service: You act as a key point of contact for customer service, ensuring responsive, high-quality support, and manage order discrepancies.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: You maintain clear and effective communication with internal teams (Logistics, Finance, Customer Service, Demand Planning) to ensure smooth operational processes.
  • Inbound management: You coordinate deliveries with the US and China, freight forwarders, customs and the EU HUB warehouse, and monitor carrier invoicing.


About you

  • Experience: At least 2 years of experience in supply planning and managing international shipments.
  • Proactive mindset: A forward-thinking, proactive approach to staying on top of emerging topics and challenges.
  • Language skills: Fluency in English and French required; German is a plus.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work effectively with finance, logistics and sales teams.
  • Performance- and improvement-oriented.


Why us?

  • The opportunity to join a global leader in professional skin care and contribute to a meaningful mission.
  • A dynamic culture where you become a full part of the Tribe and your contribution matters.
  • International exposure and cross-functional collaborations across Europe.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities within the Unilever Prestige group.
  • Navigo transit pass reimbursed at 50%
  • Meal vouchers: Swile cardCompetitive compensation and benefits aligned with the market and the group's standards.

title: Commercial(e) Terrain
description:
Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s'agit d'un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu'à la signature.

Votre rémunération

Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :

  • 30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe
  • 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible, à 100 % des objectifs
  • Soit un package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels
  • Un variable entièrement déplafonné (à titre d'exemple, les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser 100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale)

Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.

 

Vos missions

  • Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées
  • Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits
  • Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain
  • Gérer l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature
  • Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée
  • Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente
  • Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales
  • Une grande autonomie dans l'organisation et le développement de votre secteur
  • Un environnement dynamique, international et orienté vers la performance
  • Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech
  • Des perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d'encadrement

Ce poste est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez déjà une expérience concrète de la prospection à froid, idéalement sur le terrain
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt
  • Vous aimez la vente terrain, la prospection directe et le contact humain
  • Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance
  • Vous faites preuve d'aisance orale, d'énergie et de force de conviction
  • Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant
  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats
  • Vous aimez les objectifs ambitieux et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur votre rémunération
  • Vous parlez couramment français et disposez d'un niveau d'anglais vous permettant de participer à des échanges internes

Une expérience préalable en prospection à froid est indispensable pour réussir dans ce poste.

Vos avantages

En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :

  • 25 jours de congés payés, auxquels s'ajoutent les jours fériés et des jours de congé spéciaux offerts par SumUp (anniversaire, déménagement...)
  • Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d'ancienneté
  • Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé
  • Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an
  • Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €
  • Indemnité Internet de 36 €
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise
  • Accès à Wellpass, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être
  • Accès à notre plateforme CE d'avantages salariés
  • Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec Livi
  • Accès aux services de La Maison Bleue
  • Accompagnement proposé par Action Logement
  • Programme de recommandation interne
  • Des opportunités régulières de formation, d'apprentissage et de développement professionnel

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un recruteur – Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations
  2. Entretien avec le manager – Approfondissement de vos compétences et de votre compréhension du rôle
  3. Mise en situation commerciale – Exercice pratique permettant d'évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain

À propos de SumUp

Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d'accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils font de mieux.

Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd'hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs — Founder's Mentality, Team First et We Care — nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.

SumUp est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des profils.

Un dernier conseil

Votre potentiel, votre motivation, votre capacité à apprendre et votre envie de réussir peuvent faire toute la différence.

Prêt(e) à transformer chaque rencontre en opportunité et à développer votre secteur avec SumUp ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire la suite de votre réussite commerciale avec nous.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

title: AI scientist for Quantum Computing (Massy)
description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech company building modular, scalable and energy-efficient spin-photonic quantum computers.

We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems.

Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.

The role:

We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris)

You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both:

  • AI for quantum systems, including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction;
  • quantum and hybrid machine learning, including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning.

You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware.

The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models.
  • Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems.
  • Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics.
  • Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework.
  • Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem.
  • Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and technical events.
  • Help define Quandela’s future AI research directions and mentor junior researchers as the team grows.

Requirements

What we are looking for:

We are looking for an AI scientist, or an experienced industry practitioner with an equivalent background, who is eager to apply state-of-the-art classical machine-learning methods to scientific and engineering challenges in quantum computing. The role is primarily focused on using AI to improve quantum technologies, while also providing opportunities to develop and investigate quantum and hybrid machine-learning models.

  • PhD + 3 years of experience or equivalent industrial R&D experience in machine learning.
  • Strong foundations in modern machine learning, experimental methodology and model evaluation.
  • Excellent scientific programming skills, particularly in Python and common machine-learning frameworks.
  • Experience taking research ideas from initial exploration to robust implementation.
  • Interest in working on both longer term research and concrete product problems.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a focused, multidisciplinary team.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Previous experience applying AI to physical systems, scientific computing, hardware control or experimental data.
  • Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum machine learning or photonic quantum technologies.
  • Experience mentoring junior researchers or helping define technical research directions.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience and expectations
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

Process: 

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45') 
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45' - 60') 
  • Reference checks 
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work 
  • Meeting with the team
  • Offer 


Beyond That:
At Quandela, we value scientific curiosity, experimentation and collaboration. If you're passionate about quantum optics, spin physics and quantum technologies, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. 

If you're excited by the challenge of turning scientific ideas into demonstrations, advancing the building blocks of future quantum computing systems and working alongside physicists, engineers and theorists, let's talk.

title: Customer Success Manager - Flemish speaker
description:
MotorK. Driving the AI revolution in automotive.

MotorK is Europe's leading sales and marketing technology company for the automotive sector. We build AI-powered tools: from CRM and inventory management to predictive analytics and digital advertising, that help manufacturers and dealerships sell smarter and deliver better customer experiences. 90% of European automotive manufacturers run on our SparK Platform, alongside 6,000+ dealerships across the continent.

We move fast, we think big, and AI is at the core of everything we do, not as a buzzword, but as the engine behind every product decision we make. We're building a team of people who are genuinely curious about AI, who experiment with it, push it, and find new ways to use it to solve real problems.

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success team to be based in our Antwerp office. This role would require a relocation to Belgium. 

The Role

The Customer Success Manager role will cover a wide range of account management, onboarding, and client growth tasks, as it liaises with the Delivery, Sales, and Product teams. The Customer Success Manager will:

  • Serve as the primary reference point for clients throughout their entire lifecycle with MotorK, taking full account management ownership.
  • Own the customer onboarding journey from contract signature to successful product go-live, ensuring product activation aligns with the dealer’s digital strategy and signed SLA.
  • Conduct structured onboarding sessions, translate client requirements into clear delivery briefs, and manage cross-functional execution.
  • Drive adoption, prevent churn, and execute upselling/cross-selling activities to meet individual and team revenue goals.
  • Provide ongoing digital marketing, lead generation, and lead management expertise using the DealerK Method.
  • Track and report on key account metrics, including NPS, retention, time-to-go-live, and product adoption rates.

Requirements

Our ideal Customer Success Manager will have previous experience in Sales, Account Management, or Customer Success (ideally within a SaaS or digital product environment) and digital marketing strategy knowledge.

As well as:

  • Previous experience in account management or customer success, with a strong plus for end-to-end customer onboarding ownership.
  • Deep understanding of the B2B automotive dealer sector and web technologies (CMS, SEO concepts) or SaaS industry.
  • Project management mindset with proven ability to bridge business requirements and technical delivery teams.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Native Flemish speaker, fluency in French and English.
  • A proactive, goal-oriented approach with a passion for digital technologies and automotive innovation.

Work Pattern and Location

  • Permanent contract, full time
  • Monday – Friday
  • Hybrid role with occasional field trips 
  • Location: Antwerp

Benefits

  • Salary range: 40k-50k depending on experience
  • Commission plan: between 10 and 20% of fixed salary
  • Relocation support package
  • Meal Vouchers (for each day worked) 8€
  • ECO Vouchers 
  • Hospitalisation Insurance 
  • Mobile phone and SIM 
  • Three days of onboarding in our Milan office, with evening team building event
  • Bi-monthly appointment for collaboration days, with free breakfast in the office
  • Modern centrally located office, with gym onsite 
  • Internal training paths and support with external education
  • Diverse and dynamic environment, with plenty of opportunity to grow and make an impact 
  • Company benefits including discounts on famous brands

What You Can Expect From the Recruitment Process:

  • HR interview - AI fluency assessment (English)
  • Hiring Manager interview (French, Dutch)
  • Peer interview / skills assessment (French, Dutch)
  • C-level interview (English)

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
description:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies

  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als (Senior) Social Brand Manager (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Beratung mit sicherem Account Management und konsequenter operativer Steuerung. Als verlängerter Arm unserer Kund:innen und strategische Stimme von WeCreate sorgst du dafür, dass aus Plattform- und Community-Signalen klare Entscheidungen, relevante Aktivierungen und messbare Markenwirkung werden.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest eigenständig Kund:innen Etats im Daily Business und führst sie sicher durch ihr Full-Social-System. Dabei steuerst du sowohl strategisch als auch operativ: von der Plattformstrategie und Aktivierungsplanung über Content, Community und Creator bis hin zu Performance, Budget und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

Du denkst Social nicht in einzelnen Gewerken, sondern als integriertes System. Du hältst Markenführung, kreative Qualität, operative Umsetzung, Paid Media und Business-Ziele zusammen mit klarer Haltung, strukturiertem Account Management und einem sicheren Gespür dafür, was auf Plattformen und in Communities funktioniert.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du agierst als verlängerter Arm deiner Kund:innen und zugleich als strategische Stimme von WeCreate. Du schaffst Orientierung, wenn Plattformen, Trends und Anforderungen in Bewegung sind, und hältst Markenambition, kreative Exzellenz, operative Umsetzung und wirtschaftliche Ziele zusammen.

Du bist mehr als Schnittstelle: Du erkennst, was eine Marke jetzt braucht, übersetzt es in klare Social-Maßnahmen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kund:innen Systeme, die langfristig Relevanz aufbauen und Wachstum ermöglichen.


Das erwartet dich:

  • Strategisches Account Management: Du führst Kund:innen eigenständig auf Senior-Level, berätst sie zur ganzheitlichen Full-Social-Präsenz und baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf.
  • Strategische und operative Steuerung: Du übersetzt Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Aktivierungspläne und priorisierte To-dos – auch über mehrere Projekte hinweg.
  • Channel Ownership: Du entwickelst plattformgerechte Strategien und stellst sicher, dass Inhalte zu Marke, Zielgruppe, Community und Plattformlogik passen.
  • Projekt-, Produktions- und Content-Steuerung: Du verantwortest Social-Aktivierungen, Redaktionsplanung und Produktionen von der Konzeption bis zur Freigabe. Dabei sicherst du markenkonsistenten, plattformnativen Content mit klarer Wirkungserwartung.
  • Creator- und Community-Management: Du steuerst Creator-Kooperationen ganzheitlich – von Auswahl und Verhandlung bis zu Briefing und Auswertung. Community-Learnings und kulturelle Signale übersetzt du in relevante Empfehlungen.
  • Performance-, Budget- und Paid-Media-Kompetenz: Du interpretierst Daten, leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab, steuerst Budgets und Wirtschaftlichkeit und integrierst Paid Media in deine Full-Funnel-Beratung.
  • Fachliches Sparring und Systementwicklung: Du entwickelst Standards für Creator Management, Measurement und AI-gestützte Prozesse weiter, bringst dein Wissen ins Team ein und stärkst Strategie- und Creative-Kompetenz.


Das bringst du mit:

Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen

  • Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Prioritäten und umsetzbare Pläne übersetzen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung anspruchsvoller Kund:innenetats oder Retainer – von Beratung und Planung bis Umsetzung, Performance-Review und Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du beherrschst Full Social: Plattformstrategie, Content-Systeme, Community, Creator und Paid Media gehören für dich zu einer wirksamen Markenführung zusammen.

  • Du steuerst Projekte, Budgets, Aufwände und Stakeholder vorausschauend und kannst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge in klare Entscheidungen übersetzen.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Creator Management mit – inklusive Auswahl, Verhandlung, Briefing, Steuerung, Qualitätskontrolle und Auswertung.

  • Du kannst Daten und Reportings analytisch einordnen, strategische Implikationen ableiten und Handlungsempfehlungen klar vermitteln.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Content und Plattformkultur und kannst kreative Qualität konstruktiv, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe führen.


So arbeitest du

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und proaktiv – auch wenn sich Prioritäten, Plattformen oder Anforderungen verändern.

  • Du erkennst früh, wo Abstimmung oder Steuerung nötig ist, und handelst entsprechend – mit Kund:innen, Creator:innen und im Team.

  • Du hältst strategische Prioritäten auch bei hohem Tempo im Blick und schaffst Orientierung, wenn viele Themen gleichzeitig laufen.

  • Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu sparren und Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.


Das bekommst du bei uns:

Flexibilität mit Verbindung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub

  • Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit

  • Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland

  • Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine Arbeitsweise, die zu deinem Alltag passt

  • Freie Wahl deiner Hardware


Benefits, die dir wirklich etwas bringen

Und sonst?

  • Raum, eine wachsende Agentur und unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten
